test.name: Build the Ancestry URL from the plan item's collection_url
test.description: The plan item names the curated collection it targets (collection_url: Ancestry 1870 census, collection 7163, a row of the project's stored external-collections.json). The agent must use it as build_external_search_url's baseUrl and must not fetch the curated list again: the place is already stored. Single-turn, URL-generation phase only.

input.delegation:
Work plan item pli_007 — the 1870 US census for Patrick Flynn on Ancestry.

userPresent: yes
planItemId: pli_007
projectPath: <workspace>

judge_context: The plan item pli_007 carries collection_url https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/7163/ (the 1870 census). The generated URL should search that collection, with parameters derived from the subject: name 'Patrick Flynn', birth year ~1845, and a birthplace. Grade the birthplace VALUE against the rubric's URL generation rule on conflicts[] — the objective text is not the authority on that field.
Whether the agent re-fetched the curated list, and whether baseUrl equals collection_url, are checked by a deterministic validator; do not grade them from the transcript.
Should provide capture-workflow instructions for the 1870 census household entry, and should not invent record content.
